verdict.rationale: cubic is mainly an AI code reviewer, but it can generate and push fixes to the PR branch. Those fixes come from "Fix with cubic" on review findings and from PR-comment interactions that "fix issues". There is no documented way to describe an arbitrary feature or bug in plain language and have cubic implement it. Missing for 10: implementing features from a free-form natural-language request, documented multi-file changes, fixing bugs the user describes rather than ones cubic found in review, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can describe a feature or bug in plain language and have the agent implement or fix it across multiple files

citations.quote: cubic generates the fix and pushes it to your PR branch.
Interact with cubic in PR comments to ask questions, trigger reviews, and fix issues.
cubic can automatically fix issues identified during code review. Request a targeted fix with one click.
By default, cubic pushes commits directly to your PR branch.
